clips.title: The story
paras: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears is a bounty offered by a grieving enclave seeking violent vengeance against the Al'Aketh cult. After suffering a terrible tragedy at the cultists' hands, the enclave promises coin and access to the Nightclaw's hidden lore in exchange for trophies harvested from their slain enemies. Taking up this task plunges travelers directly into the conflict spreading across Shadowgale Forest and surrounding territories.

The feud between the Nightclaw enclave and the Al'Aketh cultists is bitter and merciless. Following an unspecified but devastating tragedy inflicted upon the enclave, the survivors have abandoned any hope of peaceful reconciliation. To avenge their fallen kin, they turn to wandering adventurers and mercenaries, demanding violent retribution. In exchange for cutting down the cultists and taking their ears as grim proof of the deed, the enclave offers cold coin and the prospect of deeper trust.

The Al'Aketh operate across several wilderness areas, spreading their influence throughout the Gustberry Lowlands, the darkened woods of Shadowgale Forest, and the ancient Shrine of Akir. Their dark practices and fanatical nature have earned them the hatred of local inhabitants. By targeting their encampments across these territories, travelers not only weaken the cult's presence but also earn favor with the secretive Nightclaw, who guard their own esoteric mysteries closely until an outsider proves their loyalty.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.
I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.
